1: A Haunting at the End of the Street
The ghosts of Christmas like you've never seen them.
Killer Firs
After the mysterious death of her estranged father, a young woman discovers the family Christmas tree business may be harboring a dark secret.
Love Bites
A Christmas romance unfolds between a lovelorn vampire and the black sheep of a family sworn to destroy her kind.

A criminal on the run is doomed after he hits and kills one of Santa’s reindeer. His only hope: his New Age mother and the powers he doesn’t believe she has.

Elves Ascending
A panhandling con man becomes an unwitting cult leader when he’s mistaken for the real Santa Claus.
Cakes A' Cursing
After eating a cursed fruitcake, a cocky food vlogger discovers he only has three days to live.
Cameras Rolling
A teenage bully determined to ruin Christmas for his little brother gets more than he bargained for when his sinister gift takes on a life of its own.
Phantoms Frightening
The Cratchit Brothers are hired to stop the phantom of the Saturn Playhouse from ruining the town’s Christmas pageant.
Worlds Ending
As the clock ticks down to Christmas Eve, the Cratchit Brothers discover the secret of the Playhouse and an ancient evil that threatens to unleash Hell on Earth.
